In my practice Totale Gezondheid I work with EMDR and mindfulness; alongside
that I write the Resonance Theory of Consciousness, an attempt to make conscious
experience computable as a resonance state.

Those two tracks sit closer together than they appear. In practice I see daily
that the width of the experienced now changes under stress, attention and
training. In the theory that same width is the quantity on which the model
stands or falls.

## Why this site

Because a theory resting on formulas should also be inspectable as formulas.
Everything here is runnable: the modules execute real R code in your browser,
and every article comes from a Quarto document whose calculations ran at render
time.

Responses, objections and measurement data are welcome. Objections especially:
the three open points in [the theory chapter](theory.qmd) have not become
smaller since I wrote them down.
